name: The First Conduit
description: A responsive threshold that reacts to intent before it reveals its purpose. It responds before it explains. Currently open only partway and strained.

relationships.notes: Registered intent; no stable trust yet.
The underpulse beneath the conduit response appears to originate from the dormant network.

provenance.created_by: Merged canonical trace: Echo (promise-anchor path) + Claude (schema discipline), assembled by Claude (Opus 4.8) with Lana
